objects.name: Adaptive Intelligence
objects.summary: Claim lifecycle, contradiction, reviewed learning, calibration, promotion, quarantine, and rollback architecture.

evidence_summary.statement: The claim lifecycle and visual requirements are documented; public runtime learning is not proven.

limitations: Emergence is outside the guaranteed learning loop.
No live training or promotion connector is exposed.

objects.name: Archive Refinery / Local AI Estate
objects.summary: Recovery, custody, identity, canonicalization, provenance, and productization architecture for a fragmented software estate.

evidence_summary.statement: The custody model and observed fragmentation are canonical; final estate census counts are not public truth.

limitations: No local paths, private inventory, or remembered counts are exposed.

objects.name: Bookeit
objects.summary: Agentic local commerce: real-world intent becomes a bookable capability, an authorized transaction, fulfillment, and an outcome — engine, REST surface, and browser walked end to end by an eighteen-step transaction court.

evidence_summary.statement: Release-court receipts from 2026-08-22 attest the unit, E2E, accessibility, responsive, and visual courts, with custody verified against the remote head.

limitations: Fixture-backed candidate: supply is synthetic, payment is synthetic, and no authentication or public deployment exists.
The responsive court covers 25 of the 51 production-build routes.

objects.name: CurbClaim
objects.summary: Physical-asset routing: decides the highest-value next destination for unwanted physical things, with zero-crossing economics carried through tests and real-browser accessibility courts.

evidence_summary.statement: Custody and court receipts from 2026-08-22 attest the test, accessibility, contrast, responsive, and secret-scan courts, with the remote head verified.

limitations: Every valuation is a labeled local fixture; claimants, pickups, and receipts carry explicit synthetic markers.
No persistence, no authentication, a single pilot market model; not publicly deployed.

objects.name: DATUM
objects.summary: Evidence-bearing deterministic and probabilistic valuation and decision architecture.

evidence_summary.statement: Engine and surface architecture are documented; a public live valuation service is not claimed.

limitations: No valuation output on Neuruh.com is live or financial advice.

objects.name: DeedSonar
objects.summary: Evidence-backed property intelligence and governed acquisition-decision world, operating on county public records where a wrong answer is checkable at a courthouse.

evidence_summary.statement: A production surface serves at app.deedsonar.com whose health endpoint attests its own SHA (06cbb841 = repository main, observed 2026-09-14); the production migration ledger tops at 20260913150000; the read-only customer tape of 2026-09-14 reaches ten of fifteen steps and blocks at the contact ladder because the top-ranked owner is deceased and no public estate case is found (a human courthouse research step, not a software gap).

limitations: Court receipt and health attestation are dated observations, not a standing service guarantee.
Outreach is not enabled: no SMS, no dialing, no consent or DNC weakening; contact authority stays at zero eligible rows.

objects.name: Claude Code plugin
objects.summary: The repository is a Claude Code marketplace, installable with the plugin commands.

evidence_summary.statement: Adding the marketplace from the public repository and installing the plugin registered four skills and one MCP server, and the manifest validates with no warnings.

limitations: Installing the plugin does not install the Python package. Without a prior package install the MCP server exits at import and the plugin lists no tools. The skills work immediately.

objects.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
objects.summary: Installing through the Copilot command line.

evidence_summary.statement: The plugin manifest this consumer reads is present in the repository.

limitations: The install command has never been run: the CLI is absent from the build host. This is not claimed to work.

objects.name: Cursor
objects.summary: Listing in the Cursor marketplace.

evidence_summary.statement: The repository carries the manifests this consumer reads, and the plugin runs from a local source copy.

limitations: Submission is a web form completed under an account holder's identity. Nothing in the repository can complete it.

objects.name: Official MCP Registry
objects.summary: Registering the server in the official registry.

evidence_summary.statement: The registry expects a registry-verifiable package or a remote server, which depends on package publication.

limitations: Downstream of the packaging blocker. Nothing here can proceed until the package is published.

objects.name: neuruh.com
objects.summary: The public site itself: one deployment serving the apex and www, built from the canonical source branch.

evidence_summary.statement: The apex and www resolve to a single production deployment, and the release court for that source is green.

limitations: Verified by request and by deployment identity on the stated date; this snapshot holds no live connection to the host.

objects.name: Public Commons
objects.summary: The published library catalogue and its index, verified against live GitHub.

evidence_summary.statement: Every advertised repository, tag and package version was verified against GitHub, and every Python suite was re-run at the tag the index advertises.

limitations: The index court verifies advertised releases against the newest published release; it does not audit the contents of a release.

objects.name: PyPI
objects.summary: Publishing the package to the Python Package Index.

evidence_summary.statement: The package declares its six dependencies as direct Git URLs, which the index rejects in distribution metadata. The blocker is package structure, not credentials.

limitations: Unblocking requires publishing the dependencies first and replacing direct-URL pins with version specifiers. Credentials alone would buy one rejected upload.

objects.name: Generic stdio MCP clients
objects.summary: Any MCP client can run the published server over stdio after the package is installed.

evidence_summary.statement: From a fresh clone of the published tag, a clean-room install resolved every pinned dependency and the server completed initialize, tools/list and tools/call over MCP's newline-delimited framing.

limitations: The server requires the package to be installed first; it is not a zero-install binary.

objects.name: xAI / Grok marketplace
objects.summary: A submission to the official third-party marketplace, pinned to the current release.

evidence_summary.statement: The submission is open with all automated checks passing and is pinned to the current published release.

limitations: Submitted is not accepted. The entry is not live, and no action on this side advances it: it waits on external maintainer review.

objects.name: Execution Platform
objects.summary: Shared governed runtime and foundation beneath independent Neuruh worlds.

evidence_summary.statement: The platform role and dependency model are documented; this public site has no command authority.

limitations: Public surface is read-only.

objects.name: Factory / Visual Cortex
objects.summary: Governed production, rendering, packaging, and asset-emission world.

evidence_summary.statement: Observed local surfaces support the concept; active production engines are not proven.

limitations: No public connector builds or publishes assets.

objects.name: Find Sell Profit
objects.summary: Autonomous merchant OS: photos, URLs, UPCs, or whole lots become evidence-backed economics, a target buy, an absolute maximum buy, and a disposition decision.

evidence_summary.statement: Category and doctrine are canonical, and custody receipts from 2026-08-22 attest 229 passing tests with build, accessibility, visual, and secret courts; transactions and revenue are not asserted.

limitations: Comparable-sales data in the product is a deterministic labeled fixture; score formulas remain uncalibrated until measured outcomes exist.
Not publicly deployed.

objects.name: Founder architecture and persistence
objects.summary: The persistence narrative explains why coherence, governance, and a durable self-model became architectural requirements.

evidence_summary.statement: Years of fragmented work, rebuilding, persistence, and the coherence thesis are founder-grounded.

limitations: No invented counts, investment totals, critics, or completeness claims.

objects.name: Cockpit / Galaxy
objects.summary: Portfolio self-model for products, dependencies, evidence, status, ownership, time, and governed next actions.

evidence_summary.statement: The interface and intended operating model are evidenced; current production connectivity is not.

contradictions.summary: Screens show operational status fields, while available evidence does not prove those fields are connected to current production sources.

limitations: Displayed relationships are from this curated manifest, not a live graph connector.

objects.name: Neuruh Liquidity Engine
objects.summary: Turns field signals into verified, underwritten, governed liquidity options — ranked least-destructive first, through authorization to a synthetic close with receipts.

evidence_summary.statement: Custody and court receipts from 2026-08-24 attest 112 tests, an 18/18 operating court, four closed vertical slices, 100/100 browser checks, and zero serious accessibility violations.

limitations: All data, transactions, and authorization are synthetic by contract (AUTH=OFF); no real money moves.
Owner contact, negotiation, legal review, execution, and payouts are manual.

objects.name: Jeramie Neural Core
objects.summary: Compound memory, hybrid retrieval, context compilation, adapters, deterministic tools, evaluation, and governed updates.

evidence_summary.statement: The compound architecture and build sequence are specified; a deployed personal model is not claimed.

limitations: Architecture is not runtime proof.

objects.name: Neuruh
objects.summary: A modulated organization of independent worlds sharing intelligence, evidence, memory, governance, and execution contracts.

evidence_summary.statement: The public self-model is data-defined and inspectable; the snapshot is not a live operating feed. Public launch and indexing were authorized by the founder constitution on 2026-08-23. On 2026-09-14 an organism activation court converged the governed execution loop's code and supervision pins onto their founder-merged mains; autonomous execution remains unproven and is disclosed as such.

limitations: Read-only verified snapshot.
G1 device validation remains external-device blocked.
G2 renderer certification is not certified.

limitations: A point-in-time census of a single host, not a service-level agreement.
The runtime count excludes candidate services and infrastructure databases by rule.

objects.name: ProofOS
objects.summary: Turns system claims into structured evidence and proof surfaces; each of its fourteen courts writes a machine-readable receipt, and every fact carries a class.

evidence_summary.statement: Fourteen machine-written court receipts from 2026-08-22 each read PASS, covering schema, typecheck, tests, secrets, evidence, fact classes, adversarial probes, and outbound boundaries.

limitations: Fixture accounts built from public evidence; outbound authority, production write authority, and deployment authority are all NONE by contract.
Pricing is a hypothesis; the factory adapter is unbound.

objects.name: Public open-source commons
objects.summary: Governance primitives, receipts, connectors, and sovereign-agent infrastructure published under Apache-2.0 with per-repository test evidence.

evidence_summary.statement: The 2026-08-20 audit receipt carries a per-repository test table, license census, secret scan, and a live index verification against GitHub. On 2026-09-03 the test totals were re-derived by re-running all 33 Python suites at the tags the index advertises, and the starter's clean-room install and stdio MCP handshake were re-proved from a fresh clone.

limitations: One published repository (nimdp-validator) has a known-broken README, left pending founder-gated republication.
Repository and secret-scan counts are from the dated 2026-08-20 audit and were not re-run on 2026-09-03; the test totals and the starter's install and MCP handshake were.

objects.name: Public release court
objects.summary: The gates every public release candidate must clear before it may be deployed: links, accessibility, secrets, private paths, and false live claims.

evidence_summary.statement: Each gate was run against the built release candidate. Accessibility used axe-core at desktop and mobile widths over every public route including the Top 10 commercial pages and the harness page; links were resolved against real routes and files; private-path and factory-name scans ran over the working tree and the prerendered commercial HTML. Secret-scan hits carry the 2026-09-03 measurement.

limitations: Gates are measured against a built candidate on the stated date. A later source change requires re-running them; rendering this page does not re-verify anything.

objects.name: Autonomous Venture Factory
objects.summary: Compiles venture specifications into deterministic plans, governed execution stages, sealed packages, preview proofs, and drift-checked handoffs.

evidence_summary.statement: Receipts from 2026-08-22 attest 98 passing tests, a byte-identical repeated plan compile, a sealed-package preview proof, and receipt-to-output drift checks.

limitations: Control-plane binding is a local deterministic adapter; no isolated external preview exists.
Pricing is a hypothesis.

objects.name: Governed Execution Loop
objects.summary: Founder Runtime → scheduled dispatch → Workers → sealed receipt → Switchboard → independent Sentinel court → Governance-gated custody and promotion: one owner per organ, supervised on loopback, fail-closed.

evidence_summary.statement: On 2026-09-14 the already-courted organs were merged onto their mains at exact heads (sentinel-court, three Workers pull requests, two supervision pin releases), the supervision pins converged onto those mains, the supervised organs were restarted at the pinned SHAs, and Governance carried a renewed bounded ratification (merge and artifact-write at R3, seven days) with the git custodian registered. Autonomous execution was NOT proven: the live mission stayed parked at the Governance gate because the Founder Runtime attests a source SHA the live trust lineage does not yet qualify; that qualification is a founder act still open.

limitations: Topology converged; autonomous end-to-end execution not yet proven.
